name: 90038 · Los Angeles, CA
findings: ZIP 90038 (Los Angeles) has 95 nonprofit organizations. 38 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 30 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90038 (Los Angeles) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 90038 (Los Angeles) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 45% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 31 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 90038 (Los Angeles) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 10 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.
